title: 高層建築消防分區設計
subcategoryTitleEn: Building seismic, precast and fire safety
summary: 從防火區劃的目的與火載量出發，比較灑水系統與區劃的分工，計算標準火災溫度與時間等效、防火門縫隙的漏煙、樓板邊緣縫隙的等效開口，再處理施工與裝修期間的區劃完整性、耐火試驗、樓梯加壓驗收、區劃失效時的結構臨界溫度，最後談使用管理與交接，並以高雄城中城大樓、倫敦 Grenfell Tower 與費城 One Meridian Plaza 的教訓對照。
summaryEn: Starting from the purpose of compartmentation and fire load, compare the roles of sprinklers and compartments, compute standard-fire temperatures and time equivalence, smoke leakage through fire-door gaps and the equivalent opening of slab-edge gaps, then cover compartment integrity during construction and fit-out, fire-resistance testing, stair-pressurisation acceptance and structural critical temperatures when compartments fail, and finally management in use and handover, compared with lessons from Kaohsiung's Cheng Chung Cheng Building, London's Grenfell Tower and Philadelphia's One Meridian Plaza.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「防火區劃的目的、面積與火載量」與「火災成長、灑水系統與區劃的分工」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Purpose, area and fire load of compartments" and "Fire growth, sprinklers and the division of labour with compartments": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 防火區劃的目的、面積與火載量：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Purpose, area and fire load of compartments: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「防火區劃面積」如何影響高層建築消防分區設計的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Compartment floor area” governs force, deformation or durability in “Fire compartmentation in high-rise buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 防火區劃把建築切成許多以耐火牆、樓板與防火門窗圍成的小盒子，讓火災與煙在一定時間內被限制在起火的盒子裡，爭取避難與消防搶救時間，並限制同時燃燒的面積，保護結構。水平區劃限制每層的燃燒面積，垂直區劃則以樓板、樓梯間與管道間阻止火煙向上蔓延。台灣建築技術規則以每 1,500 m² 為防火構造建築物的區劃原則，設有自動滅火設備時可減計面積；十一層以上樓層則依內裝材料以更小的面積區劃，反映高層救援困難。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「防火區劃面積」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compartmentation divides a building into boxes enclosed by fire-resisting walls, floors and fire doors and windows, so that fire and smoke stay in the box of origin for a defined time, buying time for evacuation and firefighting and limiting the area burning at once to protect the structure. Horizontal compartments limit the burning area on each floor, while vertical compartmentation uses floors, stair enclosures and shafts to stop upward spread. Taiwan's Building Technical Regulations take 1,500 m² as the basic compartment for fire-resistive buildings, allowing reduced counting where automatic suppression is installed, and require smaller compartments above the 10th floor depending on interior finishes, reflecting the difficulty of high-rise rescue. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Compartment floor area” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：火載量 Q = A·q。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Fire load Q = A·q.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要設了灑水系統，防火區劃就可有可無。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With sprinklers installed, compartmentation is optional." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「防火區劃面積」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Compartment floor area”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 防火區劃的目的、面積與火載量
knowledge.titleEn: Purpose, area and fire load of compartments
knowledge.text: 防火區劃把建築切成許多以耐火牆、樓板與防火門窗圍成的小盒子，讓火災與煙在一定時間內被限制在起火的盒子裡，爭取避難與消防搶救時間，並限制同時燃燒的面積，保護結構。水平區劃限制每層的燃燒面積，垂直區劃則以樓板、樓梯間與管道間阻止火煙向上蔓延。
knowledge.textEn: Compartmentation divides a building into boxes enclosed by fire-resisting walls, floors and fire doors and windows, so that fire and smoke stay in the box of origin for a defined time, buying time for evacuation and firefighting and limiting the area burning at once to protect the structure. Horizontal compartments limit the burning area on each floor, while vertical compartmentation uses floors, stair enclosures and shafts to stop upward spread.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要設了灑水系統，防火區劃就可有可無。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With sprinklers installed, compartmentation is optional. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「高層建築消防分區設計」的「防火區劃的目的、面積與火載量：機制與傳力路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出載重來源、構件、接點與支承的傳力邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「城市結構維護班」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與幾何版本、支承條件、荷載方向與獨立位移紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Purpose, area and fire load of compartments: mechanism and load path” in “Fire compartmentation in high-rise buildings”. Draw the load, member, connection and support load paths; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Urban structures maintenance shift” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for geometry revision, supports, load direction and independent displacement records, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「防火區劃的目的、面積與火載量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Purpose, area and fire load of compartments" is correct?
options: 只要設了灑水系統，防火區劃就可有可無。
防火區劃把建築切成許多以耐火牆、樓板與防火門窗圍成的小盒子，讓火災與煙在一定時間內被限制在起火的盒子裡，爭取避難與消防搶救時間，並限制同時燃燒的面積，保護結構。
防火區劃只是延緩火勢，真正滅火只能靠消防隊，所以區劃不必太嚴格。
optionsEn: With sprinklers installed, compartmentation is optional.

Compartmentation divides a building into boxes enclosed by fire-resisting walls, floors and fire doors and windows, so that fire and smoke stay in the box of origin for a defined time, buying time for evacuation and firefighting and limiting the area burning at once to protect the structure.
Compartments only delay a fire and only firefighters extinguish it, so compartmentation need not be rigorous.
quiz.explanation: 防火區劃把建築切成許多以耐火牆、樓板與防火門窗圍成的小盒子，讓火災與煙在一定時間內被限制在起火的盒子裡，爭取避難與消防搶救時間，並限制同時燃燒的面積，保護結構。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compartmentation divides a building into boxes enclosed by fire-resisting walls, floors and fire doors and windows, so that fire and smoke stay in the box of origin for a defined time, buying time for evacuation and firefighting and limiting the area burning at once to protect the structure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 防火區劃的目的、面積與火載量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Purpose, area and fire load of compartments: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「防火區劃面積」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Compartment floor area” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：火載量 Q = A·q。區劃面積 1,500 m²、辦公室火載量密度 q = 600 MJ/m²：Q = 1,500×600 = 900,000 MJ = 900 GJ；若因設灑水系統使區劃面積加倍到 3,000 m²，可能同時燃燒的火載量也加倍到 1,800 GJ，前提是灑水系統確實有效。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Fire load Q = A·q. A 1,500 m² compartment with an office fire-load density q = 600 MJ/m² holds Q = 1,500×600 = 900,000 MJ = 900 GJ; if sprinklers allow the compartment to double to 3,000 m², the fire load that could burn at once also doubles to 1,800 GJ, on the assumption that the sprinklers actually work. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：設計階段以防火區劃圖標示每個區劃的範圍、面積、防火時效、防火門窗與貫穿部，並與建築、機電、帷幕牆圖套繪，確認區劃線在每一層都連續閉合；審查時核對灑水系統減計面積的條件是否成立。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At design stage, a compartmentation plan shows each compartment's extent, area, rating, fire doors and windows and penetrations, overlaid with architectural, services and curtain-wall drawings to confirm that compartment lines close continuously on every floor; at review, check that the conditions for any sprinkler-based area allowance are met.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 火載量 Q = A·q。區劃面積 1,500 m²、辦公室火載量密度 q = 600 MJ/m²：Q = 1,500×600 = 900,000 MJ = 900 GJ；若因設灑水系統使區劃面積加倍到 3,000 m²，可能同時燃燒的火載量也加倍到 1,800 GJ，前提是灑水系統確實有效。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Fire load Q = A·q. A 1,500 m² compartment with an office fire-load density q = 600 MJ/m² holds Q = 1,500×600 = 900,000 MJ = 900 GJ; if sprinklers allow the compartment to double to 3,000 m², the fire load that could burn at once also doubles to 1,800 GJ, on the assumption that the sprinklers actually work. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「防火區劃的目的、面積與火載量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Purpose, area and fire load of compartments", which statement holds?
options: 防火門只要是防火材料做的，開著也能擋火。
管線穿過防火牆後，用任何填縫材料補起來就可以。
火載量 Q = A·q。
optionsEn: A fire door made of fire-resisting material still stops fire when left open.
After pipes pass through a fire wall, any filler material can seal the gap.
Fire load Q = A·q.
quiz.explanation: 火載量 Q = A·q。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Fire load Q = A·q. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 防火區劃的目的、面積與火載量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Purpose, area and fire load of compartments: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「防火區劃面積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Compartment floor area” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 設計階段以防火區劃圖標示每個區劃的範圍、面積、防火時效、防火門窗與貫穿部，並與建築、機電、帷幕牆圖套繪，確認區劃線在每一層都連續閉合；審查時核對灑水系統減計面積的條件是否成立。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At design stage, a compartmentation plan shows each compartment's extent, area, rating, fire doors and windows and penetrations, overlaid with architectural, services and curtain-wall drawings to confirm that compartment lines close continuously on every floor; at review, check that the conditions for any sprinkler-based area allowance are met. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：防火區劃圖應由建築師與消防、結構、機電專業共同簽認，並作為竣工交接文件的一部分；任何隔間變更都必須回到這張圖上檢討。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The compartmentation plan should be signed jointly by the architect and the fire, structural and services disciplines and form part of the handover documents; any partition change must be reviewed against it.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若區劃線在平面上看似完整，但在天花板上方、架高地板下方或帷幕牆邊緣斷開，火煙會繞過區劃牆擴散，使整層甚至多層同時受害；以灑水系統放大區劃面積後，若灑水系統失效，燃燒面積就超過結構與救援的假設。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Compartment lines that look complete on plan but break above ceilings, below raised floors or at the curtain-wall edge let fire and smoke bypass the walls and involve whole floors or several floors at once; once sprinklers justify larger compartments, sprinkler failure leaves a burning area beyond what structure and rescue assumed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 設計階段以防火區劃圖標示每個區劃的範圍、面積、防火時效、防火門窗與貫穿部，並與建築、機電、帷幕牆圖套繪，確認區劃線在每一層都連續閉合；審查時核對灑水系統減計面積的條件是否成立。
knowledge.textEn: At design stage, a compartmentation plan shows each compartment's extent, area, rating, fire doors and windows and penetrations, overlaid with architectural, services and curtain-wall drawings to confirm that compartment lines close continuously on every floor; at review, check that the conditions for any sprinkler-based area allowance are met.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 防火區劃圖應由建築師與消防、結構、機電專業共同簽認，並作為竣工交接文件的一部分；任何隔間變更都必須回到這張圖上檢討。
knowledge.textEn: The compartmentation plan should be signed jointly by the architect and the fire, structural and services disciplines and form part of the handover documents; any partition change must be reviewed against it.

quiz.question: 要驗證「防火區劃的目的、面積與火載量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Purpose, area and fire load of compartments"?
options: 設計階段以防火區劃圖標示每個區劃的範圍、面積、防火時效、防火門窗與貫穿部，並與建築、機電、帷幕牆圖套繪，確認區劃線在每一層都連續閉合。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
樓梯加壓的壓力越大越安全。
optionsEn: At design stage, a compartmentation plan shows each compartment's extent, area, rating, fire doors and windows and penetrations, overlaid with architectural, services and curtain-wall drawings to confirm that compartment lines close continuously on every floor.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The higher the stair pressurisation, the safer.
quiz.explanation: 設計階段以防火區劃圖標示每個區劃的範圍、面積、防火時效、防火門窗與貫穿部，並與建築、機電、帷幕牆圖套繪，確認區劃線在每一層都連續閉合；審查時核對灑水系統減計面積的條件是否成立。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At design stage, a compartmentation plan shows each compartment's extent, area, rating, fire doors and windows and penetrations, overlaid with architectural, services and curtain-wall drawings to confirm that compartment lines close continuously on every floor; at review, check that the conditions for any sprinkler-based area allowance are met. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 防火區劃的目的、面積與火載量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Purpose, area and fire load of compartments: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「防火區劃面積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Compartment floor area” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若區劃線在平面上看似完整，但在天花板上方、架高地板下方或帷幕牆邊緣斷開，火煙會繞過區劃牆擴散，使整層甚至多層同時受害；以灑水系統放大區劃面積後，若灑水系統失效，燃燒面積就超過結構與救援的假設。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Compartment lines that look complete on plan but break above ceilings, below raised floors or at the curtain-wall edge let fire and smoke bypass the walls and involve whole floors or several floors at once; once sprinklers justify larger compartments, sprinkler failure leaves a burning area beyond what structure and rescue assumed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：台灣建築技術規則以每 1,500 m² 為防火構造建築物的區劃原則，設有自動滅火設備時可減計面積；十一層以上樓層則依內裝材料以更小的面積區劃，反映高層救援困難。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Taiwan's Building Technical Regulations take 1,500 m² as the basic compartment for fire-resistive buildings, allowing reduced counting where automatic suppression is installed, and require smaller compartments above the 10th floor depending on interior finishes, reflecting the difficulty of high-rise rescue.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要設了灑水系統，防火區劃就可有可無。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With sprinklers installed, compartmentation is optional." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「防火區劃的目的、面積與火載量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Purpose, area and fire load of compartments" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

若區劃線在平面上看似完整，但在天花板上方、架高地板下方或帷幕牆邊緣斷開，火煙會繞過區劃牆擴散，使整層甚至多層同時受害。

optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

Compartment lines that look complete on plan but break above ceilings, below raised floors or at the curtain-wall edge let fire and smoke bypass the walls and involve whole floors or several floors at once.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 火災成長、灑水系統與區劃的分工：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Fire growth, sprinklers and the division of labour with compartments: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「灑水頭與火災成長」如何影響高層建築消防分區設計的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sprinkler heads and fire growth” governs force, deformation or durability in “Fire compartmentation in high-rise buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 室內火災初期以近似時間平方成長，若在閃燃前被灑水系統控制，火勢就不會擴大到整個區劃；區劃則是灑水失效或火勢超出設計時的第二道防線。兩者缺一，風險就大增。1991 年費城 38 層的 One Meridian Plaza 從 22 樓起火，未設灑水的樓層接連燃燒，共燒毀 8 層、歷時超過 19 小時並造成 3 名消防員殉職；火勢直到第一個設有自動灑水的 30 樓才被 10 個灑水頭擋住。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「灑水頭與火災成長」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Early compartment fires grow roughly with the square of time; if sprinklers control the fire before flashover, it never spreads across the compartment, and compartmentation is the second line of defence if sprinklers fail or the fire exceeds their design. Lose either and risk rises sharply. In 1991 the 38-storey One Meridian Plaza in Philadelphia caught fire on the 22nd floor; unsprinklered floors burned one after another, eight floors were destroyed over more than 19 hours and three firefighters died, and the fire was stopped only on the 30th floor, the first with automatic sprinklers, where ten heads held it back. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Sprinkler heads and fire growth” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A t² fire Q = α·t² with fast growth α = 0.0469 kW/s² reaches 1 MW at t = √(1,000/0.0469) ≈ 146 s and 5 MW at √(5,000/0.0469) ≈ 327 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「防火區劃只是延緩火勢，真正滅火只能靠消防隊，所以區劃不必太嚴格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Compartments only delay a fire and only firefighters extinguish it, so compartmentation need not be rigorous." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「灑水頭與火災成長」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Sprinkler heads and fire growth”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 火災成長、灑水系統與區劃的分工
knowledge.titleEn: Fire growth, sprinklers and the division of labour with compartments
knowledge.text: 室內火災初期以近似時間平方成長，若在閃燃前被灑水系統控制，火勢就不會擴大到整個區劃；區劃則是灑水失效或火勢超出設計時的第二道防線。兩者缺一，風險就大增。
knowledge.textEn: Early compartment fires grow roughly with the square of time; if sprinklers control the fire before flashover, it never spreads across the compartment, and compartmentation is the second line of defence if sprinklers fail or the fire exceeds their design. Lose either and risk rises sharply.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：防火區劃只是延緩火勢，真正滅火只能靠消防隊，所以區劃不必太嚴格。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Compartments only delay a fire and only firefighters extinguish it, so compartmentation need not be rigorous. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「火災成長、灑水系統與區劃的分工」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fire growth, sprinklers and the division of labour with compartments" is correct?
options: 防火區劃只是延緩火勢，真正滅火只能靠消防隊，所以區劃不必太嚴格。
標示一小時防火時效的牆，在任何火災中都一定能撐一小時。
室內火災初期以近似時間平方成長，若在閃燃前被灑水系統控制，火勢就不會擴大到整個區劃；區劃則是灑水失效或火勢超出設計時的第二道防線。
optionsEn: Compartments only delay a fire and only firefighters extinguish it, so compartmentation need not be rigorous.
A wall rated for one hour will always last one hour in any fire.
Early compartment fires grow roughly with the square of time.
quiz.explanation: 室內火災初期以近似時間平方成長，若在閃燃前被灑水系統控制，火勢就不會擴大到整個區劃；區劃則是灑水失效或火勢超出設計時的第二道防線。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Early compartment fires grow roughly with the square of time; if sprinklers control the fire before flashover, it never spreads across the compartment, and compartmentation is the second line of defence if sprinklers fail or the fire exceeds their design. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 火災成長、灑水系統與區劃的分工：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fire growth, sprinklers and the division of labour with compartments: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「灑水頭與火災成長」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sprinkler heads and fire growth” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：t² 火災 Q = α·t²，快速成長 α = 0.0469 kW/s²：熱釋放率達 1 MW 需 t = √(1,000/0.0469) ≈ 146 s，達 5 MW 需 √(5,000/0.0469) ≈ 327 s。灑水頭若在約 1 MW 前動作，火勢可被控制；延遲到 5 MW 以上，房間可能已接近閃燃。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A t² fire Q = α·t² with fast growth α = 0.0469 kW/s² reaches 1 MW at t = √(1,000/0.0469) ≈ 146 s and 5 MW at √(5,000/0.0469) ≈ 327 s. Sprinklers operating before about 1 MW can control the fire; delayed beyond 5 MW, the room may be near flashover. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以火災模擬或手算檢查灑水頭在設計火災下的動作時間，確認水源、消防泵、管徑與壓力能供應設計區域；竣工時做灑水系統的流量與壓力試驗，並核對每一層都設有灑水頭，沒有因裝修而被遮蔽或漏設的區域。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check sprinkler operating time under the design fire by fire modelling or hand calculation, and confirm that water supply, fire pumps, pipe sizes and pressure serve the design area; at completion run flow and pressure tests and verify sprinkler coverage on every floor, with no areas obstructed by fit-out or left unprotected.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: t² 火災 Q = α·t²，快速成長 α = 0.0469 kW/s²：熱釋放率達 1 MW 需 t = √(1,000/0.0469) ≈ 146 s，達 5 MW 需 √(5,000/0.0469) ≈ 327 s。灑水頭若在約 1 MW 前動作，火勢可被控制；延遲到 5 MW 以上，房間可能已接近閃燃。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A t² fire Q = α·t² with fast growth α = 0.0469 kW/s² reaches 1 MW at t = √(1,000/0.0469) ≈ 146 s and 5 MW at √(5,000/0.0469) ≈ 327 s. Sprinklers operating before about 1 MW can control the fire; delayed beyond 5 MW, the room may be near flashover. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「火災成長、灑水系統與區劃的分工」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fire growth, sprinklers and the division of labour with compartments", which statement holds?
options: 樓板本身有防火時效，就代表上下樓層已經完全區劃。
只要材料本身不燃，組成的牆或門就自動具有防火時效。

If the floor slab is fire-rated, the floors above and below are fully compartmented.
If the materials are non-combustible, the wall or door they form automatically has a fire rating.

steps.title: 火災成長、灑水系統與區劃的分工：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fire growth, sprinklers and the division of labour with compartments: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「灑水頭與火災成長」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sprinkler heads and fire growth” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以火災模擬或手算檢查灑水頭在設計火災下的動作時間，確認水源、消防泵、管徑與壓力能供應設計區域；竣工時做灑水系統的流量與壓力試驗，並核對每一層都設有灑水頭，沒有因裝修而被遮蔽或漏設的區域。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check sprinkler operating time under the design fire by fire modelling or hand calculation, and confirm that water supply, fire pumps, pipe sizes and pressure serve the design area; at completion run flow and pressure tests and verify sprinkler coverage on every floor, with no areas obstructed by fit-out or left unprotected. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：業主與管理單位應把灑水系統、消防泵、立管減壓閥與緊急電源列為同一套維護與測試計畫，任何停水或停用都要事前通報並採取補償措施，例如加強巡查與臨時滅火設備。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Owners and managers should treat sprinklers, fire pumps, standpipe pressure-reducing valves and emergency power as one maintenance and testing programme, notifying any shutdown in advance and adopting compensating measures such as extra patrols and temporary extinguishing equipment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：One Meridian Plaza 中消防立管的減壓閥設定不當，出水壓力不足，加上電力中斷，消防員無法有效滅火，火勢依靠窗戶與樓板逐層向上；灑水系統水源中斷時，世界貿易中心 7 號大樓的下層火災也同樣失控，顯示區劃必須獨立承受長時間火災。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: At One Meridian Plaza, misadjusted pressure-reducing valves on the standpipes delivered too little pressure and power was lost, so firefighters could not fight the fire effectively while it climbed floor by floor; when the sprinkler water supply was lost at World Trade Center 7, lower-floor fires likewise burned uncontrolled, showing that compartments must withstand long fires on their own. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以火災模擬或手算檢查灑水頭在設計火災下的動作時間，確認水源、消防泵、管徑與壓力能供應設計區域；竣工時做灑水系統的流量與壓力試驗，並核對每一層都設有灑水頭，沒有因裝修而被遮蔽或漏設的區域。
knowledge.textEn: Check sprinkler operating time under the design fire by fire modelling or hand calculation, and confirm that water supply, fire pumps, pipe sizes and pressure serve the design area; at completion run flow and pressure tests and verify sprinkler coverage on every floor, with no areas obstructed by fit-out or left unprotected.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 業主與管理單位應把灑水系統、消防泵、立管減壓閥與緊急電源列為同一套維護與測試計畫，任何停水或停用都要事前通報並採取補償措施，例如加強巡查與臨時滅火設備。
knowledge.textEn: Owners and managers should treat sprinklers, fire pumps, standpipe pressure-reducing valves and emergency power as one maintenance and testing programme, notifying any shutdown in advance and adopting compensating measures such as extra patrols and temporary extinguishing equipment.

quiz.question: 要驗證「火災成長、灑水系統與區劃的分工」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fire growth, sprinklers and the division of labour with compartments"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以火災模擬或手算檢查灑水頭在設計火災下的動作時間，確認水源、消防泵、管徑與壓力能供應設計區域。
鋼構只要有防火被覆，區劃失效也不會影響結構安全。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Check sprinkler operating time under the design fire by fire modelling or hand calculation, and confirm that water supply, fire pumps, pipe sizes and pressure serve the design area.
Steelwork with fireproofing is safe even if compartmentation fails.
quiz.explanation: 以火災模擬或手算檢查灑水頭在設計火災下的動作時間，確認水源、消防泵、管徑與壓力能供應設計區域；竣工時做灑水系統的流量與壓力試驗，並核對每一層都設有灑水頭，沒有因裝修而被遮蔽或漏設的區域。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check sprinkler operating time under the design fire by fire modelling or hand calculation, and confirm that water supply, fire pumps, pipe sizes and pressure serve the design area; at completion run flow and pressure tests and verify sprinkler coverage on every floor, with no areas obstructed by fit-out or left unprotected. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 火災成長、灑水系統與區劃的分工：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fire growth, sprinklers and the division of labour with compartments: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「灑水頭與火災成長」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sprinkler heads and fire growth” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: One Meridian Plaza 中消防立管的減壓閥設定不當，出水壓力不足，加上電力中斷，消防員無法有效滅火，火勢依靠窗戶與樓板逐層向上；灑水系統水源中斷時，世界貿易中心 7 號大樓的下層火災也同樣失控，顯示區劃必須獨立承受長時間火災。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: At One Meridian Plaza, misadjusted pressure-reducing valves on the standpipes delivered too little pressure and power was lost, so firefighters could not fight the fire effectively while it climbed floor by floor; when the sprinkler water supply was lost at World Trade Center 7, lower-floor fires likewise burned uncontrolled, showing that compartments must withstand long fires on their own. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：1991 年費城 38 層的 One Meridian Plaza 從 22 樓起火，未設灑水的樓層接連燃燒，共燒毀 8 層、歷時超過 19 小時並造成 3 名消防員殉職；火勢直到第一個設有自動灑水的 30 樓才被 10 個灑水頭擋住。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In 1991 the 38-storey One Meridian Plaza in Philadelphia caught fire on the 22nd floor; unsprinklered floors burned one after another, eight floors were destroyed over more than 19 hours and three firefighters died, and the fire was stopped only on the 30th floor, the first with automatic sprinklers, where ten heads held it back.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「防火區劃只是延緩火勢，真正滅火只能靠消防隊，所以區劃不必太嚴格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Compartments only delay a fire and only firefighters extinguish it, so compartmentation need not be rigorous." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: One Meridian Plaza 中消防立管的減壓閥設定不當，出水壓力不足，加上電力中斷，消防員無法有效滅火，火勢依靠窗戶與樓板逐層向上；灑水系統水源中斷時，世界貿易中心 7 號大樓的下層火災也同樣失控，顯示區劃必須獨立承受長時間火災。
knowledge.textEn: At One Meridian Plaza, misadjusted pressure-reducing valves on the standpipes delivered too little pressure and power was lost, so firefighters could not fight the fire effectively while it climbed floor by floor; when the sprinkler water supply was lost at World Trade Center 7, lower-floor fires likewise burned uncontrolled, showing that compartments must withstand long fires on their own.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「火災成長、灑水系統與區劃的分工」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fire growth, sprinklers and the division of labour with compartments" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
標示一小時防火時效的牆，在任何火災中都一定能撐一小時。

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.

quiz.explanationEn: At One Meridian Plaza, misadjusted pressure-reducing valves on the standpipes delivered too little pressure and power was lost, so firefighters could not fight the fire effectively while it climbed floor by floor; when the sprinkler water supply was lost at World Trade Center 7, lower-floor fires likewise burned uncontrolled, showing that compartments must withstand long fires on their own.
